question: Are exposure to rain and absence of flowers on the liṅga’s head treated as ritual faults?
premises: The head of the liṅga may be without flowers
The liṅga may be sprinkled by rainfall and similar causes
Proper adornment and protection are prescribed
inference: These conditions constitute ritual defects requiring correction
plain_english: When the head of the liṅga is without flowers and is sprinkled by rainfall and the like.
